failures.detail: 戒律 s1 o2: Yongjue documents and rebukes the dismissal ‘what use are precepts and code?’ and names its ensuing conduct.
戒律 s1 o2 expected '永覺元賢禪師廣錄': Yongjue documents and rebukes the dismissal ‘what use are precepts and code?’ and names its ensuing conduct.
戒律 s1 o3: The Record of the Source-Mirror quotes Fu Dashi: ‘keeping the code originally controls the arising mind; I now have no mind and pass beyond precepts and code.’
戒律 s1 o3 expected '宗鏡錄': The Record of the Source-Mirror quotes Fu Dashi: ‘keeping the code originally controls the arising mind; I now have no mind and pass beyond precepts and code.’
戒律 s1 o4: A recorded address speaks plainly of being unable to keep the precept code strictly.
戒律 s1 o4 expected '天界覺浪盛禪師全錄': A recorded address speaks plainly of being unable to keep the precept code strictly.
戒律 s1 o5: Asked why he does not follow an existing greater-vehicle precept code, Baizhang calls for fitting standards to circumstances and establishes a separate Chan residence.
戒律 s1 o5 expected '景德傳燈錄': Asked why he does not follow an existing greater-vehicle precept code, Baizhang calls for fitting standards to circumstances and establishes a separate Chan residence.
戒律 s1 o6: Zhongfeng calls precepts and code the root of the monastic community’s rites and forms.
戒律 s1 o6 expected '天目中峰廣錄': Zhongfeng calls precepts and code the root of the monastic community’s rites and forms.
